cd /workspace 2>/dev/null || cd .; python - <<'EOF'
import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream
cases = [
    ('A="line\\nnext"', 'newline'),
    ('A="tab\\there"', 'tab'),
    ("A='single\\n'", 'single keeps \\n literal'),
    ("A='esc\\'quote'", 'single escaped quote'),
    ('A="esc\\"quote"', 'double escaped quote'),
    ('A=C:\\path\\to\\file', 'unquoted literal'),
    ('A=value\\nmore', 'unquoted keeps backslash'),
]
for text, label in cases:
    rows = list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(text + "\n")))
    print(label, '->', repr(rows[0].value))
EOF
